blocks.text: Specialized Treatment for Young Adults
August 1, 2023

When we think about addiction, we tend to think of adults who are using and abusing substances. The reality is that addiction impacts adolescents and young adults as well. Individuals that struggle with substance use disorders at a younger age find themselves in a challenging situation because they will have to learn to navigate their recovery at a younger age, when they may not have had time for self-exploration or to develop the appropriate life skills needed in adulthood.

Because of this, we encourage you to consider addiction treatment programs that can provide you with specialized treatment options. These treatment programs can provide the support needed to navigate the challenges that can arise in their recovery and provide a safe place to address concerns that may not arise in traditional treatment programs.

Addiction Statistics for Young Adults

Research has shown that 11.2% of overdose deaths were among individuals between 15 and 24 years old in 2022. Approximately 11.89 million young adults, ages between 18 and 25, used drugs within the last month.

When we look at young adults in California, research has shown that teens in California are 24.46% more likely to have used drugs within the past month compared to teens in the U.S. 85% of those who used drugs were using marijuana.

Marina Harbor Detox is a young adult drug rehab in San Francisco, CA, that provides private accommodations, including a bath. By having your own space, you will have the privacy and comfort needed to feel safe and secure in our detoxification program.
Why Do Young Adults Abuse Drugs?

There are a number of reasons that young adults use drugs and alcohol. This can include peer pressure and wanting to try new things. With peers and friends trying alcohol and drugs, it can be tempting for young adults to follow the crowd. Some find that they are able to control their use, while other young adults may find that they are going down a slippery slope rather quickly.

Substance use as a young adult is viewed as a normative behavior in our society. Because of this, red flags may not be as obvious when they begin showing. Young adult substance use could be viewed as a phase or rite of passage which can dismiss the signs that they are struggling.

Young adults are also at a time of high stress and pressure in their life. They are trying to figure out who they are and what they would like to do with their life. Substances can be used to numb the emotional distress that they may be experiencing, which can be problematic if there is a lack of healthy coping skills to be used.

What Are the Barriers to Substance Abuse Treatment for Young Adults?

There are several barriers that can impact a young adult’s desire or ability to engage in addiction treatment. One barrier may be that they are concerned about talking to their parents or guardians about their use and asking for help.
For young adults who are in school, there may be a concern about taking time away from their education to get help for their substance abuse.

Young adults may have concerns about being in recovery when their friends and peers are continuing to use substances. Denial can be a powerful mindset where individuals are unable to see the consequences of their substance use.

Addiction is a mental health concern that can impact individuals of all ages and all backgrounds. Young adults are no exception to this and often find themselves in a unique situation when compared to others who struggle with substance use disorders.

Young adults experience different stressors and challenges that can contribute to their substance use and abuse. Additionally, they tend to have different triggers to be mindful of in their recovery because of their age. Specialized rehab programs for young adults can provide support and education that can have a lasting impact on a young adult’s recovery.

Marina Harbor Detox is a San Francisco young adult rehab center. Our treatment program specializes in detoxification which means that our staff is focused on supporting you through this process and helping you develop a plan that can support you when your time with us is complete.

We work with individuals who find themselves struggling with a variety of substances, including alcohol, cocaine, benzodiazepines, amphetamines, heroin, and methamphetamine. Additionally, we provide support for individuals who are living with other mental health concerns with our dual-diagnosis treatment options, including medication-assisted treatment.

Before your time at Marina Harbor Detox is complete, our staff will work with you to develop a personalized discharge plan. This plan is intended to be used as a guide when you return home and can include lists of healthy coping skills, healthy supports in your life, referrals for continued addiction treatment options, referrals for mental health treatment, and a list of known triggers.

If you have been concerned about a young adult in your life who has been using substances, it is important to know that there are professionals available who can provide the support and treatment needed for a healthy and lasting recovery. With the right resources and the proper sources of motivation, lasting recovery is possible.
